[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Javir''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] neurologist who worked on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[44 ABY]]. When an [[Attempted assassination of Admiral Nek Bwua'tu|attack]] on [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]] left him in a coma, he was brought under Javir's care.
